name: Tracecat
title: tracecat.com
shortDescription: Tracecat is an open-source automation platform designed specifically for security and IT engineers. It offers a robust alternative to Tines and Splunk SOAR, enabling users to automate their security playbooks without the need for costly add-ons. Users can trigger workflows via webhook or schedule them as cron jobs, enrich SIEM alerts, and ensure high availability with options for mission-critical alerting.
pros: No add-ons required for full functionality
cons: Potentially steep learning curve for new users
